description: This file defines the LocationService class, which manages location updates using CoreLocation's CLLocationManager. It handles authorization, location requests, start/stop updates, and significant location change monitoring, providing asynchronous interfaces and continuations.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A service class that manages device location updates, including authorization, continuous updates, and significant change monitoring using CoreLocation. It provides async methods for requesting current location and streaming updates.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Requests location authorization based on the specified mode and awaits the change.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified parameters, handling timeout and accuracy.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts location updates, either streaming continuous locations or significant location changes, returning an async stream.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes with a callback.
